The release announces that LTM's proprietary AI-powered Quantum Error Mitigation capability, named AI-QEM, is now available in the IBM Quantum Functions Catalog. LTM states it is the first Global Systems Integrator worldwide to publish a function in this catalog. The AI-QEM function allows users to apply error mitigation directly within Qiskit workflows. It uses advanced AI models to correct device-specific error patterns through classical post-processing. This method supports improved result accuracy without additional quantum processing unit time or extra qubits. The capability has been validated on IBM Quantum computers across experiments involving more than 100 qubits.

WAAREEENER.attchmntText: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on the news article published by Moneycontrol on November 11, 2026 titled "Waaree admitted misreporting solar import origin in submission to US trade commission"
WAAREEENER.voiceSummary: Waaree Energies Ltd. issued a clarification regarding a Moneycontrol article dated November 11, 2026. The company stated that the US International Trade Commission investigation covers the Indian solar industry as a whole and is not a case against Waaree. No finding, penalty, or liability was assessed separately against the company. The article referenced past shipments where modules were declared Indian-origin, while US Customs used cell origin for duty purposes. This matter was previously disclosed on June 28, 2026. The company announced the opening of its seventh resort, Nature Trails INA Resort, in Dodamarg, Maharashtra. This property marks the brand's fourth location in the state. The resort is situated in Ker, Dodamarg, near North Goa. It spans three acres and offers Vana Forest View Rooms, Ira Cottages, and Arka Cottages. Amenities include an outdoor swimming pool, a multi-cuisine restaurant named Mitra, and activities such as trekking and archery.
